topic: Nvidia: CEO Jensen Huang tritt zurück und wird 11 Tage später wieder eingesetzt (November 2026)

sources.title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director (Nvidia, 8-K)
SEC Form 8-K: NVIDIA announces CEO transition
PBS: Nvidia board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and chairman
CNBC: Trump sealed deal for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
NPR: Nvidia brings Jensen Huang back, and Trump claims credit
24/7 Wall St: Nvidia stock moves Nov 23-24
CNN: Tech stock sell-off deepens as AI fears outweigh Huang's Nvidia return
Forbes: AI selloff deepens, Nvidia down 8%

context:
- On November 12, 2026 Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member of Nvidia, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO; Harvey C. Jones became Nvidia's first-ever board chair. (SOURCE: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm)
- On November 23, 2026 the Nvidia board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang as President, CEO and board director, effective immediately, after a series of discussions and meetings with him. Kress returns to her CFO role. (SOURCE: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-board-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-president-ceo-and-board-director)
- The board said Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort; a committee of only independent directors is investigating and the investigation continues. The board said his reinstatement poses no national security risk. (SOURCE: https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-board-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-president-ceo-and-board-director)
- CNBC reported, citing people familiar with the board's thinking, that the decision was sealed by a personal promise from President Donald Trump that Huang had not broken national security laws. Trump claimed credit (NPR). (SOURCE: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/trump-nvidia-jensen-huang.html)
- Nvidia stock jumped about 31% on November 23 after the reinstatement. (SOURCE: https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/25/nvidias-top-lawyer-sold-4-5-million-of-nvidia-stock-the-day-before-its-14-plunge/)
- On November 24 the stock fell 5.86%; on November 25 it slid about 8% after the open as a broad AI/tech selloff deepened (Nasdaq about -4%), driven by worries about AI-boom sustainability, new tariffs and interest-rate fears. (SOURCE: https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/25/business/ai-sell-off-despite-huang-nvidia-return)
- Do NOT mention or speculate about personal reasons for the resignation (unverified).
